_readme: Every value here is copied from a live file in this repo, not invented. The 'source' field is path:line as of 2026-08-31. Where two surfaces (the site vs the extension) use different values for what is conceptually the same colour, both are recorded and flagged — do not silently pick one when implementing; ask product/tech-lead which is canonical, or leave them split (see 'known_splits').

bg.note: the OS-mandated dark background; also tailwind.config.ts:12 bg.DEFAULT

surface.note: card background site-wide; identical to the extension panel card (extension/content.css:13)

border-2.note: input borders, scrollbar thumb, range track

border-ui.note: identical to extension card border, extension/content.css:13

body.note: body { color } fallback, methodology page copy

on-buy.note: text colour ON a green (buy) surface — CTA buttons, the extension logo mark

buy.note: identical everywhere: tailwind accent.green, extension riq-buy, hero mock

site_token.note: canonical WATCH on every light/site surface as of 2026-09-01 — src/components/tools/free-checker.tsx:39 and src/components/landing/extension-hero.tsx now both read this via var(--color-watch), the drifted #eab308 hardcode is deleted

extension_accent.note: renamed --riq-watch-oncard — a deliberate dark-card contrast variant of site_token, not an independent third colour
lighter red — better contrast on the extension's own dark card; also used for the 'listed over buy-below' warning row

unknown.note: used for both NO DATA and NOT MEASURED verdict styles, src/app/(dashboard)/verdict/page.tsx:18,21

system_state.note: New role, 2026-09-01 (docs/product/DESIGN-REVIEW.md §2/§3). A quota/system state (LIMIT_REACHED, rate-limited, unverified email, connection failure) is not a verdict about the item, so it must never borrow a verdict colour — LIMIT_REACHED wore --color-watch's exact hex before this fix, the more serious of the two defects this pass closed. Self-serve system states (quota, rate-limit, unverified) use this neutral; a genuine failure (connection/5xx) may use color.verdict.skip's extension_accent (#f87171) as a real error signal, per design/extension-panel/system-status.html's severity split — never amber.

blue.note: also the focus-visible outline colour, globals.css:58

known_splits: CLOSED 2026-09-01 (docs/product/DESIGN-REVIEW.md §2, executed): WATCH no longer renders as three ambers. The drifted #eab308 (src/components/tools/free-checker.tsx:39, src/components/landing/extension-hero.tsx) is deleted; both now read --color-watch/#f59e0b. #fbbf24 (extension/content.css:18,32,77) is kept as --riq-watch-oncard, a documented dark-card contrast variant of the same token — not a third colour, the same relationship already accepted for SKIP below.
SKIP renders as #ef4444 (token, --color-skip) vs #f87171 (extension panel, --riq-skip-oncard — better contrast on #12151d). Deliberate, not drift.

Text 'white' also splits: site text-primary is #e8ecf4, extension card text is #eef1f7 (extension/content.css:15) and methodology page headings are #eef1f7 too (src/app/methodology/page.tsx). Close enough visually; noted so nobody 'fixes' one to match the other by accident.
The logo-mark gradient stop #0ea5e9 (extension/content.css:26, src/components/landing/extension-hero.tsx) is not in the accent scale — closest defined token is cyan #06b6d4.

confidence_note_color.note: the warm tan used consistently for the LOW-confidence / honesty explanation line across every surface — this is the closest thing the product has to a designed 'honesty' colour, and it is reused deliberately in the new panel designs

extension_font.note: the extension deliberately does NOT load Inter — it paints into a third-party page and uses the OS system font stack so it never triggers a webfont fetch on vinted.*

panel_anchor.note: bottom-LEFT is deliberate — verified against a live vinted.es item page, the right column holds Vinted's own buy button; see comment at extension/content.css:1-7

focus_ring_green.source: src/app/globals.css:165 .riq-range:focus-visible (used where the accent context is green rather than the site-wide blue)

confidence_ladder._source: https://resaleiq.dev/methodology (live), mirrored in src/app/methodology/page.tsx table under 'Verdict confidence — HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW'

HIGH.rule: n >= 30 comparable sold items AND quality score >= 70

MEDIUM.rule: n >= 10 comparable sold items AND quality score >= 40
MEDIUM.alt: OR meets HIGH's n/quality but the snapshot is stale

LOW.note: LOW is a real verdict WITH a number. It is not the same product state as INSUFFICIENT_DATA below.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.label: NOT MEASURED
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.source: src/app/(dashboard)/verdict/page.tsx:22 (VERDICT_STYLE label, still rendered as a chip on the paid dashboard). NOT in src/components/tools/free-checker.tsx as of 2026-09-01 — the hero checker's dedicated INSUFFICIENT_DATA branch (data-testid="riq-insufficient") deliberately replaces the label with a full sentence, per design/extension-panel/insufficient.html's 'no verdict tag, no number' rule; defect-2 fix, see design/README.md.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.meaning: we found the product but will not put a call on it at all — no buy_below, no sell_avg rendered. Distinct on purpose from UNKNOWN: 'the gap is ours, not the market's' (verdict/page.tsx:19-20 comment).
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.exact_n_cutoff: UNKNOWN — not present in frontend code. The design brief (OS §6, this task) specifies n<8 as the insufficient-data floor; the OS North Star also defines a trusted check as n>=8. The frontend never renders a numeric threshold for this state, so treat n<8 as the working assumption, not a verified constant, until backend/data-eng confirms it in METRICS.md.

UNKNOWN_not_covered.label: NO DATA
UNKNOWN_not_covered.source: src/app/(dashboard)/verdict/page.tsx:18, src/components/tools/free-checker.tsx:110-116 (message: "No data for that query. Use a brand and a real model.")
UNKNOWN_not_covered.meaning: the brand/model has no catalogue entry at all — a coverage gap, not a thin sample.

zero_model_brands.source: src/data/seo-brands.json lines 122, 356, 395, 512, 551, 629 (slugs present in the marketed brand list); src/app/methodology/page.tsx 'What this data cannot tell you' bullet: "For 11 of the tracked brands we have no per-model breakdown, either because the brand genuinely does not name its products (Zara, Pull&Bear, Bershka, Mango) or because our model catalogue has not been extended to them yet."

sell_through_formula.value: str = sold_observed / (sold_observed + active_listings) × 100, null (not 0 or 100) below 30 watched sales
